mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede economic slowdowns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, which typically leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last month
failure_condition: The interaction (both HOUST and RSAFS declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 indicates strong supply-side economic activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO > 105, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, which typically supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases in the last month but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over the last 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 235 signals persistent inflation that prompts monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 235, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) indicates aggressive monetary stimulus amid labor weakness, which often precedes recessions and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction (UNRATE>5.0% and FEDFUNDS<0.2%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A high quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 16200 indicates strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during early expansion.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 > 16200, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.
